verdict.rationale: Linear's own docs list importing data from other services as a capability. Its integration directory offers a Jira-to-Linear transition path, and its repo README mentions import tooling for uploading from other systems, so the core story is delivered. All three are one-line headings, though. Missing for 10: detail on which source tools are supported and what data migrates (issues, comments, attachments, statuses), plus independent hands-on corroboration of the import working.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can import my data from another tool when switching over
